text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What? Shave off time... bit by bit on 
every corner?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This was the strategy I entrusted to Tap 
Dance City. Namely—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Devising better ways to take each corner 
to shave off 0.2 seconds per turn."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A middle-distance race has 4 corners, but 
a long-distance race has 6. 0.2 × 6 = we 
can gain "1.2 seconds."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see! Slowly, slowly building up, and 
before you know it—KABOOM!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Count me in on that plan!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Uryaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wha-?! This race strategy is—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see, what she's targeting isn't the 
pace, but the course! Dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Still!! Like hell I'm gonna loseeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a plan I was confident in. But the 
child of logic managed to stay one step 
ahead of my predictions.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She did it, she did it! Air Shakur breaks 
into a broad smile over this hard-fought 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's with that smile?! I don't have time 
to be grinning around!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
That's Air Shakur for you, fresh back from 
America!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I just got back from the UK! Wait, who on 
earth are you mistaking me for!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both her late-race burst and her witty 
comebacks to the commentary were 
razor-sharp.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Shakur! Haha, and here I 
thought my strategy was pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, caught me off guard. Never thought 
she'd cut in on the corner like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've raced against all kinds of opponents, 
but you guys are the first to ever try to 
skewer me with numbers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I hate to admit it... but that was 
absurdly intense.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I see. If it made you happy, that's all I 
can hope for!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I said I don't like it!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? You're a difficult one..."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, I couldn't settle the score, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well, all they did was spook us, so all 
right! No harm done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur's deep calculations made the 
Kikuka Sho a truly valuable learning 
experience.
